title: NEW MSFS 2024 Scenery & Landmarks! Düsseldorf, Tempelhof 1970s & North Sea Offshore Breakdown
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 marketplace just received a massive wave of fresh arrivals offering an incredible range of flight experiences. Whether you want to command heavy airliners into major European hubs, take a nautical leap back to the 1970s, land a twin along tropical turquoise lagoons, or fly rotorcraft out to high-seas oil platforms, this week's drop has something special for every pilot.

In this comprehensive marketplace breakdown, we are putting the biggest new airport and landmark releases to the test to analyze structural upgrades, custom terminal interior details, short-field challenges, and offshore coverage to see which add-ons genuinely deserve a spot in your virtual hangar:

✈️ EUROPEAN AIRLINER GATEWAYS & HISTORIC HUBS
We kick off on the busy European aprons, taking a look at Düsseldorf Airport NG (EDDL) by JustSim with its A380-capable runways. Next, we analyze Sarajevo International (LQSA) by Terrain Simulation—famous for its dramatic 3.2° mountain valley approach—before visiting Biarritz Pays Basque (LFBZ) near the Spanish border. Finally, we take a nostalgic leap back to Cold War Germany with Berlin Tempelhof 1970s (EDDI), complete with vintage Pan Am 727s, BAA Viscounts, and static military transports!

🏝️ EXOTIC INTERNATIONAL DESTINATIONS
Next, we head overseas to explore the idyllic island scenery of Bora Bora Motu Mute V2 (NTTB) by Pearl Simulations in French Polynesia, followed by Ghana's northern gateway, Tamale International Airport (DGLE) by Silver Crest.

🛩️ NORTH AMERICAN GA & REGIONAL FIELDS
For short-field and general aviation enthusiasts, we head to Fernandina Beach Municipal (KFHB) on Amelia Island, Florida by Spinoza—packed with custom details, static warbirds, and MAS*H Easter eggs. We also visit Roosevelt Municipal (74V) in Utah by UK2000 Scenery, and test our short take-off and landing skills at Hartford Municipal (KX0F) for STOL practice.

🚁 VFR LANDMARKS & OFFSHORE INFRASTRUCTURE
We round out the update over central Europe with Landmarks Frankfurt by FlyDirect, adding over 200 handcrafted buildings to Germany's financial capital. Lastly, Aerosoft brings high-stakes rotorcraft operations to MSFS 2024 with Offshore Landmarks North Sea, featuring 388 helipads, 196 airports, wind farms, crane vessels, and supply ships across the North Sea!

Are you loading up a heavy jet for Sarajevo, taking a vintage airliner into 1970s Berlin, or hauling cargo out to North Sea oil platforms? Let me know in the comments below: which of these packages is landing on your hard drive first?

If this structured marketplace breakdown helps you plan your next flight route, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism updates!
